hereHead: You are here: Phases 21 and 28 built and red-teamed, Phase 23 docs done (2026-09-03); smokes pending; open: license, then 19
here: Phase 20, connectivity hardening, is built, red-teamed, and QA-matrix passed (2026-09-02). Nine feature commits took the transport from a LAN protocol to a WAN one: an N-ready datagram envelope with a 16-hex session token and a QUIC-style PATH_PROBE challenge-echo before any new source address is trusted (4425e80); a UPnP/NAT-PMP port mapper, CGNAT verdict and connection doctor (e8649f6); RTT/loss supervision, a symmetric UDP-blocked TCP fallback and bounded outbound queues (1598734); a 60 s in-session reconnect grace with a 15 s link-death rule that exempts combat, saves and stalls (3197379); the payload diet, which cut a 30-ship fleet tick from 9,282 B to 1,008 B and chunks NPC_FLEET_MOTION under 1,200 B (6cfce04); an optional coop.password nonce challenge, per-address abuse limits and the CoopPeerLink peer table (64bef68); and a latency audit that re-derived the ENGAGE_GUEST handoff in time-to-contact terms and closed the market-open race (fe1ee25). Red-team pass: three reviewers over 64bef68 raised 34 findings and all 34 were fixed (04a8676 + 0d59163, merged d97094f, 1,773 green). Two were live-reachable: a half-open socket replaced inside one poll produced no disconnect edge and locked the returning guest out for good, and a second drop inside an open grace window tore the session down and then accepted a resume against a null session id. QA matrix (shaped loopback via clumsy, all six profiles PASS): 30 min at 100 ms RTT / 2% loss / 5% reorder with no transitions and 0.04 game-days of drift; a 5% loss spike; a 30 s outage that resumed inside the grace with both dialogs on screen; a 95 s outage that expired at exactly 60 s and tore down cleanly; a full UDP block that flipped both sides into TCP fallback in ~10 s and recovered 5 s after the block lifted; and a 50%-reorder profile with no rubber-banding. The wiretap saw a 920 B maximum composed datagram and zero over 1,200 B across roughly 35,000 samples. Tier 3 is verified against real firmware (MikroTik hAP, RouterOS 7.23.3) after the router's UPnP internal interface was moved off the address-less bridge onto the VLAN that holds the LAN address. Real-Internet smoke PASSED the same evening on 3d3f41b: host behind UPnP tier 3 on the MikroTik, guest tunnelled out through AmneziaWG via -ProxiedJvm so it arrived from another network; the UDP return address validated through the tunnel, fleet state stayed on UDP for the whole 10-minute baseline with zero transitions and zero coop WARN, host p95 RTT 52 to 181 ms, clocks within 0.5 game-seconds. The wrong-password run first: three rejects, then a 30 s refusal of the address. Two guest-side findings from that run (F4 no back-off and no on-screen reason after a password reject, F5 a silent reconnect that waited out the host's 15 s deadline) were fixed the same night in 080eaaf: a password reject is terminal for the launch and the HUD says so, other rejects back off to 5 s, and every new connection opens a lobby round. The live re-check passed the same night: one reject, zero reconnects, reason on screen. Three UX findings from the grace-expiry profile were fixed the same day in 2e916b9 (a "Wait 5 more minutes" button, releasing the coop-owned pause hold when the session goes active, and holding the guest paused while it has no session); and the Phase 12c manual residue (claim race, sell-back + hire click-throughs, feel pass). Phase 29 M2 followed and was certified on the six-profile matrix (2026-09-03). 2026-09-03: Phases 28 and 23 were pulled into V1 (user decision) while Phase 21 was in build. Same day, Phase 21 was built (lobby with ready-up and a cancellable countdown, guest connecting screen, three desync dialogs with a greppable [COOP-DOCTOR] line, a transient "Coop Stats" page; 5014011), Phase 28 in full (options registry and file stack 6000241, synced host policy plus the "Coop Options" page 85b07cf), and Phase 23's docs and scripts (8ee7bf6). A three-reviewer red-team pass over 21 and 28 M1 raised 34 findings, all fixed in ec8617c; the suite went from 1,855 to 2,213 green. The two-instance smokes for 21 and 28 have not been run yet. Next: those smokes, the license choice that closes 23, then 19.

attention.head: Phases 21 and 28 built + red-teamed; two-instance smoke pending; Phase 23 needs a license choice; then 19
attention.body: Phase 29 M2, adaptive state-stream cadence, is built (2026-09-03, 5f01a98, 1,851 green): the host moves each link between 10 Hz and a 5 Hz floor from p50 RTT, loss and queue backlog with a 30 s clean window before climbing back, the UDP-blocked fallback is now just the floor pin, and the mirror interpolation delay sizes itself from arrival jitter. It passed all six shaped-matrix profiles the same night (loss, RTT, UDP-block pin, flap guard, jitter; one calibration finding, the ceiling in the delay formula, fixed in 025c374), so Phase 29 is done and the order moves to Phase 21. Before it, Phase 20 was built, red-teamed and matrix-passed (2026-09-02): nine feature commits, 34 red-team findings all fixed, and six shaped-loopback profiles PASS including a 30 s outage that resumed inside the grace window and a full UDP block that fell back to TCP in about 10 seconds. Its real-Internet smoke passed the same evening (host behind UPnP, guest tunnelled out through AmneziaWG, UDP validated through the tunnel, 10 min clean at 52 to 181 ms p95 RTT) and the live wrong-password run rejected three proofs and refused the address for 30 s; the two guest-side lobby findings from it (F4 password reject now terminal with an on-screen reason, F5 no silent reconnect) were fixed the same night in 080eaaf (1,798 green) and live re-checked the same night on the tunnel path. Three UX findings from the grace-expiry profile were fixed the same day in 2e916b9. That unblocks Phase 29 M2 (adaptive cadence), which needs 20's CoopLinkQuality/LINK_STATUS and is next in the order, followed by 21 and then 19. Still open from before: the Phase 12c 3-item manual residue.

attention.head: Host starts unpaused before the guest connects
attention.body: Closed 2026-09-03 by the Phase 21 lobby: the host loads into a lobby dialog with the world held paused by the coop-owned hold until every player is ready and the host presses Start (live smoke still pending). Original report: after loading into the campaign the host ran unpaused until the guest joined — the connect-time pause hold covers only the handshake window, not the load-to-connect gap. Owned by Phase 21 (pulled into V1 the same day, user decision): the lobby's force-pause-until-all-ready closes it. Interim etiquette: the host pauses manually after load until the guest is in.

attention.head: Parked Phase 14 fallout (cosmetic/UX)
attention.body: Synthesized customs pursuit reads below vanilla quality (works — chase/give-up/stand-down/catch all pass — but motion is coarser than the engine's own steering); jump-point fleet pop-in near the guest (vanilla's pop-in avoidance is host-relative); and with the two players parked in different populated systems, only one gets ambient spawns (single currSpawnLoc, no-new-fields constraint). D-mod replication for mirrors landed with Phase 16; full loadout replication stays parked. The coarse synthesized-pursuit motion largely predates Phase 29 M1's kinematic drive — re-judge it at the next customs encounter before spending anything on it. Grey-fleet flicker and the unknown-market warn were fixed by 14b. Full list with suspects: PHASE14_SPIKE_NOTES.md "Known issues".

attention.head: Six vanilla classes are forked (pinned 0.98a-RC8)
attention.body: The guest-presence family (RouteManager, PlayerVisibleFleetManager, DisposableFleetManager + two subclasses, SourceBasedFleetManager) plus the pre-existing Misc/procgen forks ride the coop-forks.jar classpath shadow. A Starsector update requires re-extracting each file and re-applying the small additive diffs; the shared runtime guard (CoopPresenceRegistry.getForFork) loudly disables the presence terms on a version mismatch instead of drifting silently. Re-fork procedure: phase11-rng-determinism.md.

attention.head: Ziggurat test start to remove at Phase 23 packaging
attention.body: The COOP TEST Ziggurat start (option 6) must be removed or dev-gated before any public build (Phase 23). The forced tutorial skip and forced Normal difficulty are permanent mod behavior, not dev conveniences: the tutorial rewrites Galatia and Easy's per-client sensor bonus would desync fleet views, and solo play with the mod enabled is unsupported by policy — solo players disable the mod (decided 2026-08-19).

attention.head: Phase 24 rescoped INTO V1 (2026-06-10) — BUILT 2026-08-25, VERIFIED 2026-09-01
attention.body: Shared-faction colonies, industries, and raids are V1 scope, built, and verified — one shared player faction (separate per-player factions stay out), three milestone commits landed 2026-08-25 with the suite at 1108 green, and the two-instance live smoke passed on 2026-09-01. See P24.

attention.head: The plan was enriched on 2026-06-10
attention.body: The 2026-06-10 enrichment added the authoritative Phase Status Ledger, the hardening-first build order, new sub-phases (6b / 7b / 7c / 12b / 12c), rescoped Phase 24 into V1, and added post-V1 phases 25–29. Since then, Phase 29 (2026-08-20) and Phase 21 (2026-08-24) were also pulled into V1. Phase 7’s fast-forward verdict is partly superseded by 7b. When the ledger and a phase’s checkboxes disagree, the ledger wins.
